description: This Java class represents a response to a 'CreateThing' command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the created Thing, and managing response metadata. The class is part of a specific package related to modifying 'things' and implements serialization/deserialization of JSON payloads.

classes.name: CreateThingResponse
classes.description: Represents a response to a create thing command, encapsulating the created Thing object and related response metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new CreateThingResponse instance with a given Thing and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CreateThingResponse from a JSON string or JSON object, given the appropriate headers.

methods.name: getThingCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Thing.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID of the created Thing, throws if not present.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the created Thing for a specific schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer representing the resource path of the response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the JSON payload representing the created Thing to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the response, replacing headers.
